subcategory: privacy: knowledge-distilled parametric RAG (documents translated to LoRA)
task: Open-domain and multi-hop QA without sending plaintext documents to the model
problem: Standard RAG uploads plaintext documents (privacy risk); Parametric RAG (PRAG) needs per-document QA synthesis and fine-tuning (high latency) and DyPRAG generalises poorly out of distribution.
architecture: DistilledPRAG: documents are masked with a special token and mapped to LoRA parameters by a parameter generator (LongT5 encoder); the generator is trained by distillation to match a standard-RAG teacher's hidden states and logits on 289,079 synthetic single- and cross-document QA pairs generated by DeepSeek-V3.
retriever: standard retriever of top-N documents (documents then parameterised)
knowledge_source: Wikipedia documents of the QA datasets, injected as generated LoRA weights
llm_or_encoder: LLaMA 1B/8B, Mistral-7B; LongT5 encoder for the parameter generator

datasets.name: 2WikiMultihopQA (2WQA)
datasets.details: training split used for training; 30,000 documents sampled; dev set in-domain test

datasets.name: HotpotQA (HQA)
datasets.details: out-of-distribution test, first 300 dev questions per sub-task

key_results: LLaMA-8B average F1 36.1 vs 33.8 for standard RAG, 29.6 for DyPRAG and 28.2 for PRAG.
LLaMA-1B average F1 28.3 vs 24.6 for standard RAG and 27.0 for PRAG.
Inference latency 0.3 s with LLaMA-1B vs 0.6 s for PRAG plus 18 s of offline LoRA synthesis per new document.
strengths: Avoids sending raw documents while matching or exceeding standard RAG F1 in the reported settings.
Stricter out-of-distribution protocol than prior parametric RAG work; checks train-test document overlap.

limitations.text: Remains an approximation of standard RAG; LoRA representations may miss nuanced cross-document interactions in complex multi-hop cases.
Privacy-utility trade-off: encoding documents into LoRA loses fine-grained details.
Privacy is argued by design (no plaintext upload) rather than measured with attacks.

title: Privacy-Preserving Reasoning with Knowledge-Distilled Parametric Retrieval Augmented Generation
